# Third-party QZ Tray scripts

Place offline copies of the following files here when CDN access is not available:

- `qz-tray.js` (matching the QZ Tray version used by MyDent)
- `jsrsasign-all-min.js`

The Flutter web build will automatically fall back to these local files if the CDN cannot be reached. Make sure you update the copies whenever the upstream versions change.
